subject: Pilot extension & sandbox credit request — staged milestones suggested
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@platformlab.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 17 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot extension request — SSO blocker

Hi Jonas,

Quick note from our side: the Platform Lab engineering team hit an SSO integration blocker yesterday related to our IdP certificate rotation. The fix is in progress but it pushed our demo + integration window out by ~10 business days.

Given that the current pilot window ends on 2028-04-21, would Redwood consider a two-week extension and a modest sandbox credit so our engineers can finish validation without running up charges? We attached the integration logs and a short note from our eng lead (cc: rajiv).

We'd be grateful for anything that keeps the pilot momentum. Happy to join a quick call today if that helps.

Thanks,
Samira
Samira Khan
Head of Integrations | Platform Lab

Hi Samira — thanks for the heads up and for sending the logs. Sorry to hear about the cert rotation pain. I've looped in Marissa (CS) and Ben (accounts) to scope an appropriate runway/top-up.

We can triage quickly and I expect we can offer a two-week extension plus a small sandbox credit, pending Marissa's sign-off and a short mutual action plan. Can Marissa/Ben weigh in?

— Jonas

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 17 Apr 2028 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot extension request — SSO blocker

Marissa / Ben — forwarding Samira's notes and logs. TL;DR: Platform Lab's IdP cert rotation caused a validation stall. They need ~10 business days; current pilot ends 2028-04-21.

Proposal: 2-week extension (new end date 2028-05-05) + $3,000 sandbox credit earmarked for integration testing. Condition: a short mutual action plan with 2 milestone checkpoints (SSO validation, webhook stress test) and weekly syncs.

Deal: PL-2028-0921 (HubSpot link below). I've attached the logs for context. Approvals required: Marissa for credit allocation, Ben for deal margin/terms.

HubSpot: https://redwood.hubspot.com/deals/PL-2028-0921

Thoughts? If agreed, I'll send Samira a formal confirmation and the MAP template.

— Jonas

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 18 Apr 2028 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot extension request — SSO blocker

Thanks for the context. I reviewed the logs — looks like a transient cert chain mismatch (should be straightforward once their IdP flips the cert). I'm comfortable approving a two-week extension and the $3k sandbox credit, contingent on a brief mutual action plan and two checkpoint deliverables so we can keep the pilot productive and measurable.

Suggested MAP items (high level):
- Milestone 1 (by 2028-04-26): SSO validation (successful login from 5 test accounts)
- Milestone 2 (by 2028-05-03): End-to-end webhook & load validation (50 req/s for 10 min)
- Weekly 30-min syncs (Wednesdays) during the extension window
- Sandbox credit usage limited to integration/testing; we'll monitor consumption and notify if thresholds exceed expected usage

I'll attach a one-page MAP template and the internal authorization PDF. If Ben is good on margins, we can send to Samira today.

Attachment: MAP-template.docx
Attachment: sandbox-credit-authorization.pdf

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood

Subject: Approval: Pilot extension & sandbox credit for Platform Lab (PL-2028-0921)

Hi Samira — glad we could align. Redwood will approve the following for Platform Lab's pilot:

1) Pilot extension: +2 weeks; new pilot end date 2028-05-05.
2) Sandbox credit: $3,000 USD applied to the Platform Lab sandbox environment, for integration/testing only.
3) Conditions: The mutual action plan Marissa proposed (SSO validation by 2028-04-26; webhook/load validation by 2028-05-03), and weekly check-ins on Wednesdays.

I've attached the sandbox authorization and the MAP template. Please review and reply-all with the filled MAP (one pager) so we can finalize the credit application and lock the extension.

DocuSign: https://redwood.docusign.com/PL-2028-0921-extension (for an updated pilot amendment)

If you'd like, I can schedule a 20-minute sync today or tomorrow with our integrations lead.

Best,
Ben Carter
